Maya: Quick sync — postmortem action items from the token-count / delayed-usage incident. Need owners for: invoice corrections, backfill run, public comms, and incident recurrence mitigation. Can we confirm assignments by EOD?

Liam: I'll own the invoice corrections. I've drafted a credit memo template. Assigning JIRA FIN-348.

Sophia: I'll take backfill run. Need access to the corrected ingest snapshot and compute window. ETA Tue EOD.

Devin: I'll dig into the recurrence pattern — looking at Kafka consumer lags and our metering replayer. Found 2 recurring spikes from 2026-03-10 to 03-12.

Aisha: Thanks. Billing needs final numbers before next bill run (Thursday). Liam, can you provide expected credit amounts by Wed noon?

Liam: yep, aiming for Wed 11:30. Quick note — the credits will be issued as negative line items, invoice adjustments recorded under INV-432.

billing-bot: Created ticket INV-432 for invoice adjustment (linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INV-432)

Devin: For the backfill, Sophia — here's the query I'll use to validate token delta:

```
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_before, SUM(tokens_after) as tokens_after
FROM metering_snapshot
WHERE snapshot_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-12'
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING ABS(tokens_after - tokens_before) > 1000;
```

Sophia: thanks. I plan to run the backfill in staging first, then a small canary in prod (100 accounts). Can we schedule canary Thu 02:00 UTC? ops-bot will coordinate.

ops-bot: Scheduling canary window Thu 02:00-03:00 UTC. I'll post a reminder 1h before.

Maya: Recurrence mitigation action: Devin + Eng-Platform to add alert for ingestion lag > 5min and auto-replay window. Owner: Devin. ETA Fri EOD.

Devin: Confirmed.

Aisha: I'm tracking comms. We'll send customer-facing note after credits post. Owner: Aisha. ETA Fri noon.

Liam: Will attach credit calc spreadsheet here when ready.

Sophia: After canary, I'll post results and tag this thread. If backfill succeeds, I'll create PR for backfill config and small runbook blurb.

Maya: Thanks all. Summary of owners:
- Invoice corrections: Liam (JIRA INV-432)
- Backfill: Sophia (canary Thu 02:00 UTC)
- Recurrence detection + mitigation: Devin
- Customer comms: Aisha

Please update JIRA tickets and mark blocked items. We'll reconvene Fri 10:00 PT for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
